what_happened: verify-deploy.sh's --only-gate validation is hardcoded to the range 1-23 (two error messages + one numeric bound) and already rejects the existing gate 24, confirmed live: 'bash verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 24' -> ERROR out of range (must be 1-23). The new gate 25 this task adds would inherit the identical defect unless the bound is widened/derived dynamically from gate_registry_ids in the same edit.

A naive broad scan corpus (@extensions, @repo, or all of scripts/) for the new verdict-extraction-anchoring lint would false-positive far beyond the dispatch's 4 named exemptions: dozens of ordinary test-assertion lines across scripts/tests/*.sh that legitimately grep a test subject's [FAIL]/[VIOLATION] output, plus a real pre-existing naive-anchor extraction site at orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh:788 (SGR-safe in practice via a manual pre-strip, but outside this task's file_scope). Recommended fix (in report 01): scope the lint's default scan corpus narrowly to verify-deploy.sh + gate-verdict-extract-lib.sh + scripts/lint/*.sh only, which naturally excludes all of this without inventing new allowlist entries.
